exposure: stage of pregnancy (third trimester, day of delivery, postpartum)
outcome: levels of circulating Treg subsets (CD4DimCD25Hi, CD4+CD25HiFoxp3+, CD4+CD25HiCD127-/dim)
Foxp3 expression levels in CD4DimCD25Hi Treg subset
cohort: The study participants included 43 healthy pregnant women and 35 nonpregnant women.
finding: The CD4DimCD25Hi Treg subset significantly decreased on the day of delivery relative to the third trimester, and all Treg subsets significantly increased postpartum compared to the third trimester and the day of delivery, with Foxp3 expression ratios also showing dynamic changes across these periods.
